capabilities: Render the active note's inbound and outbound links as a ranked sidebar list
Show unlinked mentions in both directions as ghost rows with one-click link buttons
Rank links by graph proximity using Adamic-Adar or Resource Allocation scores
Suggest notes two links away at depth 2 as link predictions
Display chosen frontmatter properties or the link's context line under each title
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes performance figures and explains rejected ranking alternatives.
intentEvidence: The local graph, rendered as a list instead of a force-directed blob, with the outgoing links and backlinks panes
motivation: A sidebar is tall and narrow, so a graph canvas wastes most of it and a table view needs horizontal scrolling.
problem: The local graph wastes a tall, narrow sidebar with a force-directed canvas, and links are split across four separate panes (outgoing, backlinks, and unlinked mentions in both directions).

relations.evidence: Ported from Seek's parked feature/active-note-anchoring branch.

summary: Sidebar view that renders the local graph as a ranked list of inbound, outbound and unlinked-mention links, with properties or link context under each title.
